defects.description: ParseRow accepts a repeat factor of any magnitude and Decode appends one row per repetition, so a single row line whose factor the sender chooses makes the decoder build millions of rows, although the README refuses a factor above MaxRepeat.

trigger.expected: D1 Decode(header rows=1, one row with x2000000) -> rows=0 err=batchdec: count above the block limit: repeat factor of "socks|3 x2000000", limit 1000
trigger.actual: D1 Decode(header rows=1, one row with x2000000) -> rows=2000000 err=<nil>

defects.why_missed: The declared row count in the header is capped, so the block looks bounded and the suite exercises that cap, the column cap and a repeat of four; the per-row factor that multiplies a single line is the one count nobody compares with a limit.
